claim.text: The Q1'26 flat-to-down print ($10,253M vs $10,270M) was a pause, but Q2'26 re-accelerated sharply.

report_location.paragraph: - **Revenue acceleration is dramatic.** Revenue grew from $7,685M (Q2'25) → $9,246M → $10,270M → $10,253M → $11,536M (Q2'26). That is **+50.1% YoY** (11,536 vs 7,685) and **+12.5% QoQ**. The Q1'26 flat-to-down print ($10,253M vs $10,270M) was a pause, but Q2'26 re-accelerated sharply.

source_support.label: Verified: the saved source content supports this claim
source_support.reason: The material shows Total Revenue of 10,270M for 2025-12-31, 10,253M for 2026-03-31, and 11,536M for 2026-06-30. Comparing these, Q1'26 (2026-03-31) was down only 17M from the prior quarter, which supports 'flat-to-down' and a pause characterization. Q2'26 (2026-06-30) then rose by 1,283M versus Q1'26, about +12.5% QoQ, which supports the claim that it re-accelerated sharply. The 'sharply' wording is a qualitative characterization of the stated +12.5% sequential increase, not a separate numeric assertion requiring an unstated assumption.
